A single number that presents the number of wins the player added
to the team above what a replacement player (think AAA or AAAA) would add.

oWAR + dWAR does not equal WAR.
Adding would count positions twice.

A set of formulas developed by Bill James and others
that estimates a player’s total contributions
to a team’s runs total.
This is computed with the "technical" formula when possible.
If SB or CS data is missing, the "basic" formula is used.
If HBP, IBB, SH, SF, or GIDP data is missing, the "stolen base" version of the formula is used.
Team Runs Created is the sum of player Runs Created. Adj. Batting Runs Adjusted Batting Runs
A set of formulas developed by Gary Gillette, Pete Palmer and others
that estimates a player’s total contributions
to a team’s runs total via linear weights.
0.0 is an avg performance, <0 is worse than avg and >0 is better than avg Adj. Batting Wins Adjusted Batting Wins
A set of formulas developed by Gary Gillette, Pete Palmer and others
that estimates a player’s total contributions
to a team’s wins with his bat.
0.0 is an avg performance, <0 is worse than avg and >0 is better than avg Extra Base Hits Extra Base Hits

The percentage of games a team with nine of this player
batting would win. Assumes average pitching and defense.
This uses the Pythagorean win pct formula with the player's RC/G for runs scored and the league's R/9 as runs allowed. Sacrifice Flies Sacrifice FliesFirst tracked in 1954. Intentional Bases on Balls Intentional Bases on Balls

Given the bases occupied/out situation, how many runs did the batter
or baserunner add in the resulting play.
Compared to average, so 0 is average, and above 0 is better than average Win Probability Added (WPA) Win Probability Added for Offensive Player
Given average teams, this is the change in probability
caused by this batter during the game.
A change of +/- 1 would indicate one win added or lost. Situ. Wins Added (WPA/LI) Situational Wins (WPA/LI)
It is the sum of WPA divided by the leverage index for each play.
WPA depends greatly on the context of the at bats.
This stat does not. Championship WPA (cWPA) Championship Win Probability Added for Offensive Player
Given average teams, this is the change in probability, displayed in percentage points.
A change of +/- 100% would indicate one world series win added or lost. Base-Out Wins Added (REW) Base-Out Wins Added (REW)

Victor Martinez is 47 years old. When was Victor Martinez born? Victor Martinez was born on December 23, 1978. Where was Victor Martinez born? Victor Martinez was born in Ciudad Bolivar, Venezuela. How tall is Victor Martinez? Victor Martinez is 6-2 (188 cm) tall. How much did Victor Martinez weigh when playing? Victor Martinez weighed 235 lbs (106 kg) when playing. How many seasons did Victor Martinez play? Victor Martinez played 16 seasons. Is Victor Martinez in the Hall of Fame? Victor Martinez has not been elected into the Hall of Fame. What position did Victor Martinez play? Victor Martinez was a Designated Hitter, Catcher and First Baseman. How many hits did Victor Martinez have? Victor Martinez had 2,153 hits over his career. How many home runs did Victor Martinez have? Victor Martinez had 246 home runs over his career. What was Victor Martinez's average? Victor Martinez had a .295 average over his career. How many teams has Victor Martinez played for? Victor Martinez played for 3 teams; the Boston Red Sox, Cleveland Indians and Detroit Tigers. How many World Series has Victor Martinez won? Victor Martinez has never won a World Series. When did Victor Martinez retire? Victor Martinez last played in 2018. What are Victor Martinez's nicknames?
